text:
maya: eval-bot flagged a pretty large BLEU drop for en->ar on the nightly longform ecommerce set, model=rwd-v2-int8. baseline ~9.2 -> 5.1. samples look like punctuation and parentheses are getting reordered to the LTR side, breaking flow. dashboard: https://ci.redwood/evals/1965432100 :eyes:
eval-bot: nightly-eval rwd-v2-int8 (2026-03-20): en->ar BLEU delta -4.1 (9.2 -> 5.1). top failure ids: ecom_1243,ecom_1302,ecom_1407. sample output snippets show comma/period placement flipped relative to reference. full diff: https://ci.redwood/evals/1965432100/details
cheng: who touched quant/fused kernels yesterday? i saw PR #4123 merged late last night. :thinking_face:
akhtar: that was me — PR 4123 (commit abcdef1) landed yesterday morning. it includes a small change in the fused attention/kv index math to optimize BPE segment concatenation. didn't expect RTL implications but possible.
sara: can someone paste one of the failing examples (orig / golden / float32 / int8)? quick repro will help triage.
maya: here's one sample (copied directly from eval harness):
```
SRC (en): "Compact travel umbrella (folds to 11") with water-repellent coating, ideal for beach trips."
REF (ar): "مِظَلَّة سَفَر مُضغوطة (تطوى إلى 11\") مع طلاء مقاوم للماء، مثالية لرحلات الشاطئ."
OUT_fp32: "مِظَلَّة سَفَر مُضغوطة (تطوى إلى 11\") مع طلاء مقاوم للماء، مثالية لرحلات الشاطئ."
OUT_int8: "مِظَلَّة سَفَر مُضغوطة \")تطوى إلى 11(" مع طلاء مقاوم للماء، مثالية لرحلات الشاطئ."
```
Notice the parentheses and quotes got flipped around the token boundary in the int8 output. that's the pattern across many failures.
cheng: wow that's clear. looks like token ordering around punctuation got inverted. could be an off-by-one or sign on the KV position index after kernel fusion. i'll start a git-bisect against the fused change. suggested local repro:
```
python tools/eval.py --eval-id 1965432100 --model rwd-v2 --quant int8 --filter dataset=ecom_long_ar --samples 50
```
also try `--model rwd-v2 --quant fp32` as control.
akhtar: i ran a quick local run on my dev-gpu, same seed, 50 samples. ~48% of samples show punctuation inversion on int8. attaching a short grep of tokens: shows negative index wrap in fused kernel logs. i'm suspecting the recent change to `kv_pos += segment_len` when segment_len is unsigned.
maya: ok. action items: akhtar please open a revert PR for the fused attention micro-opt (mark as hotfix). cheng/sara can you add a targeted regression test to nightly with 200 punctuation-heavy en->ar samples and assert BLEU drop <= 1.0 vs fp32? for production routes, let's canary fallback en->ar-longform to fp32 until fix. @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary rollback?
deploy-bot: canary rollback queued: rollback rwd-v2-int8 -> rwd-v2-fp32 on route en->ar-longform in region us-east-1. ETA ~4m. logs: https://deploys.redwood/rollbacks/78910 :gear:
sara: i'll add the regression test to the eval harness (tests/eval_regressions/en_ar_punct_heavy.yml) and wire it into nightly. will assert BLEU and a simple token-order diff check.
cheng: thanks all. akhtar — ping me when you have a bisect commit range and i'll help with the kernel-level repro and a minimal reproducer.
maya: thanks team. keeping this thread for updates; i'll close once the revert lands and nightly passes. :thumbsup:
